blocksProduced.definition: Blocks produced by all agents, summed from the final snapshot.

canonicalHeadAgreement.definition: Share of agents sharing the most common local head at the final tick (agent-local head observations).

convergedRunRate.definition: Mean of the converged flag: 1.0 when every agent shares one head, otherwise 0.0.

staleBlocks.definition: Agent-local stale observations summed per run; one block may count once per agent.

competingBlocks.definition: Agent-local competing observations summed per run; derived from the same local data as stale blocks.

orphanBlocks.definition: Agent-local retained orphan observations summed per run.

activeForks.definition: Active forks reported by the final blockchain state.

transactionsCreated.definition: Transactions accepted into mempools during the run.

transactionsIncluded.definition: Unique transactions included in the canonical chain.

transactionSuccessRate.definition: Included unique transactions divided by created transactions; 0.0 when none were created.

transactionsPerSimulationTick.definition: Included transactions divided by simulation ticks; simulation time, not wall-clock TPS.

blockProductionRate.definition: Produced blocks divided by completed simulation ticks.

messageThroughput.definition: Delivered messages divided by completed simulation ticks.

messagesSent.definition: Cumulative network queue events created by the run.

messagesDelivered.definition: Cumulative messages delivered by the scheduler.

messagesDropped.definition: Cumulative messages dropped by configured packet loss.

averagePropagationDelayTicks.definition: Mean scheduled delivery delay in simulation ticks; not physical network latency.

blockPropagationDelay.definition: Mean block propagation delay in simulation ticks from production to peer delivery.

maliciousActionsAttempted.definition: Malicious actions attempted by simulated Byzantine agents; not a security claim.

blocksWithheld.definition: Blocks produced by simulated Byzantine agents but withheld from broadcast.

conflictingAttestations.definition: Conflicting attestations generated by simulated Byzantine agents.

byzantineAgents.definition: Agents instantiated as Byzantine for the run.

inactiveAgents.definition: Agents marked inactive for the run.

activeAgents.definition: Agents that are neither Byzantine nor inactive.
